data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: element
sections.summary: An important or essential part of something, such as a dish or recipe.

senses.definition: an important or essential part of something; one of several features or aspects that together make a whole
examples: Timing is an essential element when cooking pasta correctly.

answers.answer: Fresh herbs add an important element to the dish.
Fresh herbs add important element to dish.
An element is a type of dessert.

sections.question: hors d'oeuvre
sections.summary: A small savoury dish served as an appetiser at the start of a meal or at a party.

senses.definition: a small savoury dish or snack served as an appetiser before the main course of a meal, or passed around at a party
examples: The waiter offered us hors d'oeuvres as we waited for the main course.

answers.answer: They served hors d'oeuvres before the main course.
They served a hors d'oeuvre before main course.
Hors d'oeuvre are a type of drink.

sections.question: ingredient
sections.summary: A food item used in making a dish or recipe.

senses.definition: one of the foods or substances that is used to make a particular dish or recipe
examples: Eggs are a key ingredient in most cakes and pastries.

answers.answer: Flour is a basic ingredient in bread.
Flour is basic ingredient in bread.
An ingredient is the person cooking the meal.

sections.question: instructions
sections.summary: Directions that tell you how to do, prepare, or use something step by step.

senses.definition: directions or information that tell you how to do, use, or operate something, often given as a series of steps
examples: Always read the instructions before assembling the furniture.

sections.question: list
sections.summary: A written record of a series of items, names, or things to do.

senses.definition: a written or printed series of items, names, or things arranged one after another
examples: She made a list of everything she needed to buy.

answers.answer: A list is a cooking method.

sections.question: meat-free
sections.summary: Containing no meat; suitable for people who do not eat meat.

senses.definition: containing no meat; suitable for vegetarians or people who do not eat meat
examples: They introduced several meat-free options to the restaurant menu.

answers.answer: Meat-free is a type of dessert.

sections.question: menu
sections.summary: A list of the food and drinks available at a restaurant or café.

senses.definition: a list of the food and drinks available to order in a restaurant or café, usually printed on a card or sheet
examples: She looked at the menu and chose the grilled fish.

answers.answer: The waiter gave us the menu.
A menu is a type of ingredient.

sections.question: method
sections.summary: A particular way or process of doing or preparing something.

senses.definition: a particular way or process of doing, preparing, or achieving something, especially one that is planned and systematic
examples: Slow cooking is a traditional method used to make the meat very tender.

answers.answer: This recipe uses a traditional method.
A method is a sweet dessert.

sections.question: nibble
sections.summary: To eat small amounts of food by taking small, gentle bites.

senses.definition: to eat something by taking small, gentle bites; to eat small amounts of food slowly or nervously
examples: He nibbled on a biscuit while waiting for dinner.

answers.answer: A nibble is a full meal.

sections.question: pudding
sections.summary: A sweet dish served at the end of a meal; used in British English as a general term for dessert.

senses.definition: a sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal; in British English, a general term for any dessert
examples: For pudding, she ordered a warm chocolate brownie with ice cream.

answers.answer: For pudding, we had ice cream.
For a pudding, we had ice cream.
